question: What is the percentage increase in material cost under the PM POSHAN scheme in April 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**9.50%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Centre enhances material cost by 9.5% under PM POSHAN scheme.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Scheme Overview:**

 
 
• 
 
The scheme is called **Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman (PM POSHAN)**.

 
 
• 
 
It serves **hot cooked meals** to over **11 crore** students.

 
 
• 
 
Target group includes students in **Balvatika** and classes **1 to 8** in government and government-aided schools.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Cost Enhancements:**

 
 
• 
 
The material cost has been increased by **9.50%**.

 
 
• 
 
The Central Government will incur an additional cost of **954 crore rupees** in **2025-26** due to this enhancement.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Foodgrains Provision:**

 
 
• 
 
The Central Government provides approximately **26 lakh metric tonnes** of foodgrains through the **Food Corporation of India (FCI)**.

 
 
• 
 
The government bears **100% cost** of foodgrains, including:

 
 
• 
 
A subsidy of about **9,000 crore rupees** per annum.

 
 
• 
 
**100% transportation cost** of foodgrains from FCI depots to schools.
